integrity: The exhaustive standard-library verifier reconstructs its own finite incidence input, all matchings, the difference hypergraph and both relevant subset layers; author-level validation only, no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact result for the single Heawood graph; no claim on all cubic cages or algorithmic complexity. A general-priority risk persists from unindexed enumerations, and the 2007 original grid-paper PDF could not be fully read. The date is the verified initial public submission of the 2009 seed paper, not the date of this theorem.
title: Global perfect-matching forcing in the Heawood graph: seven edges, 8064 optima, thirty symmetry classes
